verdict.rationale: Navan documents receipt scanning, AI (Ava/MCP) querying flagged expenses over policy thresholds, and identifying policy violations, which covers spend auditing and fraud/policy flagging. However there is no explicit documentation of AI auto-suggesting expense categories/memos or specifically detecting duplicate transactions. missing for 10: explicit auto-categorization/memo suggestion feature, explicit duplicate-detection capability, independent hands-on validation of receipt-reading accuracy.
